title: 第25章 计划第26章 问题
content_zh:
走一步看一步，杨威不想走来走去的，对于未来他是有计划的
带回储物袋中有早已准备好的青云宗福祉令，这是仙家给后代留的凭证，只要持着此令便可走后门进宗
当然这也是最坏的打算了，是在存亡之际才会做出的选择
寻常大宗每年秋季都会举办一次升仙大会为宗门吸收新鲜血液，如果一切顺利今年杨威便会去参加选拔
在这乱世之中做个散修是很难的，杨威七世就是个很好的例子，纵使有一技之长但没有背景靠山最后还是被暗算死了
宗门可不是学校能比拟的，它是集学阀，财阀，军阀，三位一体如国家般的大平台
与大赵官家之间关系更像是合作而非隶属，就如联合国与国家之间的关系一般，大国完全可以无视规章制度
弱肉强食的森林法则在哪里都一样
重要的资源都被宗门把持着，大到灵石矿场，小到筑基丹所需主药
散修看似自由却有诸多不便，因为一个人是终究斗不过一群人的
无知并不可怕，可怕的是无知而不自知，可怕的是固执与傲慢
杨威前世最高也只是金丹中期，放在浩瀚的修行界算不得什么
所以这一世虽然资源都有了却也是要进入大宗继续深造的
在此之前他要苦修提升修为，灵根资质不好若想进入排名靠前的大宗便需要让对方看到潜力
最好的结果是在升仙大会前筑基，这个任务很困难，时间有限只能尽量去做了
如囫囵吞枣般杨威吃下数颗色泽透明布满道纹的极品丹药随后打坐运转周天
早课炼法力，午间休息片刻，晚课炼肉身，如此反复进步神速
短短一月时间便已突破练气八重，哪怕是杨威最得意的八世也未曾做到这般迅速
没有好的资质便用丹药弥补，没有好的天赋那便重复去做
杨威没有怪天怪地的习惯，保持着不以物喜不以己悲的平静心态

终于在修炼了不知多少个日夜后，窸窸窣窣的星光照耀在了他的身上
星辰观想法终于有了一些起色，神识中升起一颗闪耀着炫彩的星辰与外面的星光交相辉映
“古恒星”
杨威在感应到星辰之力的同时也知晓了这颗星辰的名字
“古往今来，成大事者，不拘小节，持之以恒”
似乎是对他恒心的嘉奖般，这第一颗掌握的星辰之力的名字格外应景
杨威周身亮起的光芒只持续了片刻便熄灭了，雷声大雨点小只是一颗并不能起到实质性作用，除了肉身力量加强了些外便没有其他好处了
若想如之前看到那般成就星辰真身，至少需要七颗以上才能产生质变
对此杨威反而喜悦无比，炼体之路本就不是一朝一夕能看到效果的
前期越是难修的功法后面就越强，这个道理在修炼紫霞神功时他就明白了。
一个月后白慧君按照约定时间便来取丹了，当得知其中有两颗中品后，平时淑女沉稳的大小姐也忍不住露出了惊喜的目光
杨威却是无喜无悲一颗心扑修行上，与其寒暄了几句后便送客了
同一天似得知杨威有空了，一身锦袍的周法也来敲门，他同样是来求药的
天魂宗残党似乎在大赵扎根了，寨子里急需能够抵御神魂攻击的丹药
这可又是个技术活，在丹药里面最难炼制的便是神魂类的
俗话说肉身损坏，缺胳膊断腿都是小事，但要是三魂七魄有损那就不得了
对于一个修士真正的死亡也是神魂破灭，魂魄才是一切的载体，它是修行最基本的根
想要治疗神魂损伤异常困难，人丢了魂便是死，丢了一魄轻则失忆重则痴呆
这也是为何周法这次来找杨丹师的原因，没办法外面的那些炼丹师实在不堪重用
好在他要炼制的不是修复神魂一类的丹药而是能够提前防御神魂攻击强大修士神魂的丹药

预防永远比救治更加的简洁有效也更加的容易操作
此次要炼制的的是一味名为“固魂丹”
的防御性丹药，有着短暂守护元神的功效
在得知对方准备好了丹方和药材后，杨威当即便答应了下来
能够增强寨子的整体实力对于他来说也是一种保障
content_en:
Take one step at a time, Yang Wei doesn't want to walk around, he has plans for the future
There is a Qingyun Sect Welfare Order that has been prepared in the storage bag. This is a certificate left by the Xian family for future generations. As long as you hold this order, you can enter the sect through the back door.
Of course, this is also the worst plan. It is a choice that is made at the moment of life or death.
The Ordinary Sect holds an Immortal Ascension Conference every autumn to attract new blood to the sect. If all goes well, Yang Wei will participate in the selection this year.
It is difficult to be a casual cultivator in these troubled times. Yang Wei VII is a good example. Even though he had skills but no background, he was assassinated in the end.
The sect is not something that can be compared to a school. It is a trinity of academics, chaebols, and warlords that is as big as a country.
The relationship with the Zhao official family is more like cooperation than affiliation. Just like the relationship between the United Nations and countries, big countries can completely ignore the rules and regulations.
The law of the jungle is the same everywhere.
Important resources are controlled by the sect, ranging from the spiritual stone mine to the main medicine required for the Foundation Establishment Pill.
Loose cultivators seem to be free, but they have many inconveniences, because one person cannot defeat a group of people after all.
Ignorance is not terrible. What is terrible is ignorance without knowing it. What is terrible is stubbornness and arrogance.
Yang Wei's previous life was only in the middle stage of the Golden Elixir, which was nothing in the vast world of cultivation.
Therefore, even though we have all the resources in this life, we still have to enter a large school to continue our studies.
Before that, he had to practice hard to improve his cultivation. If he didn't have good spiritual root qualifications and wanted to enter a high-ranking sect, he needed to let the opponent see his potential.
The best result is to build the foundation before the Ascension Conference. This task is very difficult. Time is limited and we can only do our best.
Yang Wei swallowed several high-quality elixirs that were transparent and full of lines, and then meditated to circulate around the world.
Practice your magic power in the morning class, take a short break at lunch, and practice your physical body in the evening class. Repeatedly, you will make rapid progress.
In just one month, he has broken through the eighth level of Qi training. Even Yang Wei's most proud eighth life has never been able to do so quickly.
If you don’t have good qualifications, use elixirs to make up for it; if you don’t have good talents, just do it again and again.
Yang Wei does not have the habit of making strange things happen, and maintains a calm mind that does not take things for granted and does not take sorrow for oneself.
Finally, after practicing for countless days and nights, the rustling starlight shone on him.
The idea of observing the stars finally made some progress, and a shining star rose up in the consciousness and complemented the starlight outside.
"Ancient Star"
When Yang Wei sensed the power of the star, he also knew the name of the star.
“Throughout the ages, those who have achieved great things have done so regardless of small details and persevered.”
As if to be a reward for his perseverance, the name of the first star to master the power is particularly appropriate.
The light that lit up around Yang Wei only lasted for a moment and then went out. The thunder was loud and the raindrops were small, but they had no real effect. Apart from strengthening the physical strength, there was no other benefit.
If you want to achieve the true form of the stars as we saw before, you need at least seven or more to produce a qualitative change.
Yang Wei was extremely happy about this. The path to body refining is not something that can be achieved overnight.
The more difficult the technique is to practice in the early stage, the stronger it will be later on. He understood this when he was practicing the Zixia Magic Technique.
A month later, Bai Huijun came to pick up the pills at the agreed time. When she learned that there were two middle-grade pills among them, the usually ladylike and calm eldest lady couldn't help showing a look of surprise.
Yang Wei, on the other hand, was neither happy nor sad. His heart was focused on his spiritual practice. After greeting him for a few words, he saw off the guests.
On the same day, it seems that Yang Wei was free. Zhou Fa, who was dressed in a brocade robe, also came to knock on the door. He also came to ask for medicine.
The remnants of the Tianhun Sect seem to have taken root in Da Zhao, and the village is in urgent need of elixirs that can resist the attacks of the spirits.
This is another technical job. Among the elixirs, the most difficult ones to refine are the divine soul ones.
As the saying goes, it is a trivial matter if the body is damaged, if an arm is missing or a leg is missing, but if the three souls and seven souls are damaged, it is a big deal.
For a monk true death is also a godWhen the soul is destroyed, the soul is the carrier of everything. It is the most basic root of spiritual practice.
It is extremely difficult to treat damage to the soul. If a person loses his soul, he will die. If he loses his soul, it will range from amnesia to dementia.
This is also the reason why Zhou Fa came to find Master Yang this time. There was no way that the alchemists outside could not be reused.
Fortunately, what he wants to refine is not an elixir to repair the soul, but an elixir that can prevent the soul from attacking the soul of a powerful monk in advance.
Prevention is always simpler, more effective and easier to operate than treatment.
What we are going to refine this time is simply called "Soul-Reinforcing Pill"
The defensive elixir has the effect of temporarily protecting the soul.
After learning that the other party had prepared elixirs and medicinal materials, Yang Weidang agreed.
Being able to enhance the overall strength of the village is also a guarantee for him
